how_to_apply: Visit the official recruitment website: https://sbcrecruitment.in
Read the guidelines carefully before filling the online application form.

Keep scanned copies ready of: passport-size colour photograph (100-150 KB, light background), signature on plain white paper in black ink (80-150 KB), caste certificate (if applicable, 100-1000 KB), Birth Certificate/Matriculation/SSC certificate, highest educational qualification proof, Ex-Servicemen certificate (if applicable), and PwBD-related certificates (if applicable).
Register and fill in the online application form, providing a valid and active email ID and mobile number (no change allowed once entered).
Select up to three choices of examination cities from the list provided.
Pay the applicable examination fee online via net banking, Credit/Debit Card, or UPI, before the last date.
Submit the application and take a printout for personal record; do not send the printout to SBC(V).
Only one online application per post is allowed per candidate. Candidates applying for multiple posts must submit separate, complete applications and pay fees separately for each post.
important_instructions: Only online applications will be accepted; no other mode of application is permitted. Mistakes made while filling the online application form cannot be corrected by SBC(V) after final submission. Applicants must not submit multiple applications for the same post; if submitted due to unavoidable circumstances, the application with the higher registration number will be considered. Candidates should carry the Admit Card printout along with an original, valid photo ID (Aadhaar/PAN/Passport/Driving License/Voter's Card/Bank Passbook with photograph) to the examination venue; Ration Card and Learner's Driving License are not accepted. The name on the Admit Card must exactly match the name on the photo ID; any mismatch will result in the candidate not being allowed to appear for the examination. Mobile phones and other electronic gadgets, including Bluetooth devices, are banned within examination centre premises; possession (even switched off) is considered use of unfair means and may lead to debarment and criminal proceedings. Candidates working in Central Government must produce a No Objection Certificate (NOC) when demanded, failing which their candidature will be cancelled. TA/DA is not admissible for the CBT and Skill Test; candidates must make their own arrangements for lodging/boarding. Facility of scribe/compensatory time (20 minutes per hour) is available for eligible PwBD/PwD candidates as per the prescribed medical certificate and undertaking formats, detailed in the notification. Court jurisdiction for any dispute regarding this recruitment lies exclusively with Courts/Tribunals in Visakhapatnam. SBC(V) reserves the right to modify/cancel/postpone/suspend/terminate the recruitment process at any stage without notice.

content_sections.heading: SBC Visakhapatnam Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: The Computer Based Test (CBT) will consist of bilingual (Hindi/English, except General English) multiple choice questions, over a duration of 120 minutes. Minimum Qualifying Marks (Aggregate): UR - 35%, OBC - 30%, All other categories - 25%.

content_sections.heading: SBC Visakhapatnam Selection Process
content_sections.text: All applicants (CA'A', CH, FED-OG, CMTD-OG) must appear in the online Computer Based Test (CBT). There is no Endurance Test/Skill Test for CA'A' and CH applicants; the final provisional merit for these posts is based on CBT merit only. For FED(OG): candidates are shortlisted in a ratio of at least 1:15 (vacancy:shortlisted) based on CBT merit for a qualifying Endurance Test (carrying filled sand & water buckets 100m in 45 seconds, 20 squats, 15 push-ups, 15 bent-knee sit-ups), followed by a qualifying Skill Test (driving tests, vehicle mechanism knowledge, tyre-changing, minor repairs, firefighting awareness, etc.). For CMTD(OG): candidates are shortlisted in a ratio of at least 1:15 based on CBT merit for a qualifying Skill Test (driving on ramp/road, road rules, vehicle mechanism knowledge, routine vehicle checks). There is no Endurance Test for CMTD(OG). Skill Test/Endurance Test is qualifying in nature only; the final merit list for FED(OG) and CMTD(OG) is based on CBT merit, subject to qualifying in the respective test(s). In case of a tie in aggregate marks, it is resolved first by Date of Birth (older candidate ranked higher), and if still tied, by alphabetical order of first names. Provisional appointment is strictly based on relative merit position in the CBT, subject to document verification, medical examination, and other requirements.

faq.question: Q1. What is SBC Visakhapatnam Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is Ship Building Centre, Visakhapatnam's recruitment drive under Advt. No. 3201/2026 for 9 Group 'C' posts - Construction Assistant 'A', Construction Handler, Fire Engine Driver (Ordinary Grade), and Civilian Motor Transport Driver (Ordinary Grade).

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in SBC Visakhapatnam Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 9 vacancies are available: Construction Assistant 'A' (3), Construction Handler (2), Fire Engine Driver-OG (3), and Civilian Motor Transport Driver-OG (1).

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for SBC Visakhapatnam Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for receipt of online applications and fee payment is 14 Sep 2026 (23:00 hrs). Applications opened on 22 Aug 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for SBC Visakhapatnam Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The age limit is 18 to 27 years as on the closing date for receipt of online application, with relaxation available for ST, PwBD, and Departmental candidates.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification for SBC Visakhapatnam Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It varies by post: 10th pass + ITI/NAC + 2 years' trade experience for Construction Assistant 'A'; 10th pass + ITI certificate for Construction Handler; 10th pass + valid heavy vehicle license + 3 years' driving experience for Fire Engine Driver; and 10th pass + valid light vehicle license + 3 years' driving experience for CMTD.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for SBC Visakhapatnam Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs. 350/- (excluding taxes/charges) for general candidates; SC/ST/PwBD/eligible Ex-Servicemen/Women candidates are exempted.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply online for SBC Visakhapatnam Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply online through https://sbcrecruitment.in by registering, filling in the application form, uploading required documents, and paying the fee before the last date.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for SBC Visakhapatnam Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection is through a Computer Based Test (CBT) for all posts. For Fire Engine Driver and CMTD posts, shortlisted candidates additionally undergo a qualifying Endurance Test and/or Skill Test.

faq.question: Q9. What is the exam pattern for SBC Visakhapatnam Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The CBT has 100 questions across General Intelligence, General Awareness, Quantitative Aptitude, and Trade Syllabus (for CA'A'/CH) or General English (for FED/CMTD), over 120 minutes, with minimum qualifying marks of 35% (UR), 30% (OBC), and 25% (other categories).

faq.question: Q10. When is the SBC Visakhapatnam CBT examination scheduled?
faq.answer: The Computer Based Examination is tentatively scheduled for October 2026; the exact date, time, and venue will be communicated via admit card.
